title: DDM ENSO index candidate
description: One proposed observed index for the ENSO briefing in src/impact/enso.ts. Encodes the five wiring gates from planning/user-research/2026-09-07-enso-expansion-proposal.md section 4. A candidate advances past its decision record only when every gate is true and every receipt is filled.

slug.description: Kebab-case identifier for this candidate file. Also the default register slug.

name.description: Plain-language name as a reader would see it, e.g. 'equatorial upper-ocean heat content anomaly'.

status.description: candidate: filled in, no DR yet. decided: DR ruled. wired: block, claim and spec landed. declined: DR ruled against; keep the file.

name.description: The issuing agency exactly as it names itself, spelled out on first use.

product_url.description: The product page a reader is sent to, where the issuer states the base period and rules. Never the bare data file.

url.description: The machine-readable file the builder fetches. Null until verified live.

base_period.description: As the issuer states it, e.g. '1991-2020'. An anomaly with no stated base period cannot be shown (DR-033 rule).

carries_published_date.description: True if the file or its page states when it was published, so the claim's dates.published can be filled.

fetched_by.description: Always the builder. The browser never fetches an upstream file.

last_modified.description: The Last-Modified header verbatim. A frozen file (see DR-031 on wksst8110.for) fails this gate.

quote.description: The issuer's own sentence saying what the index is. Under 15 words. This is what the claim may quote; the claim may not interpret.

horizon.description: current unless the issuer frames the product itself as an outlook.

kind.description: observation: what the index shows now. issuer-outlook: only when the issuer publishes it as an outlook and the claim quotes that framing.

evidence.description: The makeClaim evidence value. analyzed for an issuer index read; derived for a DDM computation on issuer numbers; outlook only for kind issuer-outlook.

proposed_text.description: The full sentence as it would render. Must pass tests/enso-forecast-language.ts.

contains_forecast_language.description: Result of running proposed_text against the forbidden list. Must be false to advance.

decision_record.description: The DR id once opened. Null while status is candidate. No id is minted in this file.

ledger_path.description: Path under planning/user-research/ where the need is recorded.

who.description: Role, not name, e.g. 'Tribal water program staff'.

quote.description: What they asked for, in their words.

key.description: camelCase key on EnsoSnapshot, e.g. nino34Weekly.

type_stem.description: PascalCase stem for the Point and Series types.

required_blocks_unchanged.description: RONI and ONI remain the only required blocks.

gates.description: The five wiring gates. All five true before any code lands. Each is a summary of the receipts above, not a substitute for them.
